host.description: IP address of the network interface the server listens on. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port for incoming HTTP connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds. Connections beyond this duration are closed.

compression.description: Enable or disable gzip compression for HTTP responses (helps reduce bandwidth).

root.description: Absolute or relative path to the top-level directory where video files are stored.

index_dir.description: Subdirectory under `root` to serve as default index landing page (e.g., 'main'). Leave empty to disable.

index_template.description: Path to custom HTML template for directory listings. If omitted, a basic auto-generated listing is used.

log_file.description: Path to server log file. Use '-' to log to stderr instead.

log_level.description: Verbosity level of logging. Choose from: debug, info, warn, error, fatal.

access_log.description: Enable detailed access logging (every request with IP, path, status, etc.).

services.description: List of optional named services (each with its own root path and mount point). Useful for multi-tenant or segmented deployments.

name.description: Unique identifier for the service (used as section header, e.g., 'projects', 'archive').

root.description: Base path for files served by this service (may be absolute or relative to `server.root`).

mount.description: URL path prefix under which this service is exposed (e.g., '/docs' → http://host:port/docs/...). If omitted, service root is exposed directly at `/`.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in config comments (optional).

enable_basic_auth.description: Enable HTTP Basic Authentication for all endpoints.

password_file.description: Path to htpasswd-formatted file containing usernames and hashed passwords (supports md5, bcrypt, sha1).
